run_spm_train: run the sentencepiece trainer with command-line arguments to train a tokenization model
run_sentencepiece_training: run SentencePieceTrainer.Train by passing all CLI args through to the sentencepiece library
create_sentencepiece_model: create a SentencePiece model by invoking spm_train.py with input corpus and model prefix flags
train_tokenizer: train a subword tokenizer using sentencepiece via the spm_train.py CLI wrapper script
review_spm_train_wrapper: review the spm_train.py wrapper that forwards CLI arguments to SentencePieceTrainer.Train
